release.notes: v0.1.3 documentation parity hotfix and M1-M4 promotion host cores. README.md is now the English default with a reciprocal Korean README.ko.md; release-harness enforces this contract on every run and publish. This release also publishes the Type A registration, Type B-cold provisioning, and Type B-live handoff host cores that landed on main after v0.1.2. UI, shortcut, and automatic skill activation (M5) remain out of scope.
